overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by taking over two months to approve open and executive session minutes. Because the Board acknowledged the violation and approved the minutes and adopted a plan, the AG deemed its remedial action sufficient and ordered nothing further.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to approve minutes of 10 open meetings (Sept. 2014 to Dec. 2014) in a timely manner.
allegations.key_passage: Although the Board typically meets on a weekly basis, the Board took more than two months following each of the meetings at issue to approve minutes.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to approve minutes of 13 executive session meetings (Sept. 2014 to Jan. 2015) in a timely manner.
allegations.key_passage: Although the Board typically meets on a weekly basis, the Board took more than two months following each of the meetings at issue to approve minutes.
